# Public observed Doradca Smaku registration subtree

Source: https://www.doradcasmaku.pl/rejestracja, observed 2026-09-16, Polish. HTML and CSS recovered byte-for-byte from the existing `docs/form-observations/doradcasmaku-2026-09-16/signup.*` observation. The sanitized native form asks for nickname, email, password and confirmation. Resource URLs and field values were removed; navigation links use an inert placeholder.

Tests add synthetic values only. Both identity alternatives are returned for an explicit user choice. No account was created and no production authentication or submission is claimed. Post-click dismissal, where tested, is synthetic.
